scope: Missing Power Up and Strike Supers

records.name: Fighting Pose F
records.effect: Temporarily causes incoming damage to deplete Stamina instead of Health; grants hyper armor.

records.name: Fighting Pose H
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 61 - The Cell Games Continued

records.name: Lovely Cyclone
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 135 - "Ribrianne, Defender of Love and Justice"
records.effect: Short-range twirling rush that pulls in the opponent; additional input can cancel into a tackle and the completed move improves stamina damage against guarding opponents.

notes: All three names were absent from docs/data/skills.json. Dedicated Xenoverse 2 sources explicitly establish Fighting Pose F/H as Power Up Supers and Lovely Cyclone as a Strike Super. Fighting Pose F and H cost 0 Ki; Lovely Cyclone costs 100 Ki. CaC availability is supported by their player-facing unlock methods.
